newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South Africa's Chubb issues profit warning.
newsitem.headline: South Africa's Chubb issues profit warning.

text.p: Chubb Holdings Ltd said on Friday that first half profits were expected to be "substantially" below year-ago levels and no improvement was expected in the second half.
"As a consequence, the profits for the full year are expected to be below those of last year," the company said in a statement.

The engineering group said an investment and reorganisation programme had proceeded more slowly than anticipated. The company had also experienced erosion in margins and a sharp increase in overheads, in part due to start-up costs.
Chubb reported attributable income of 18.37 million rand in the year ended March 31, 1996, from 17.19 million in the previous period.
